actions.description: Copy a file or folder to another location
actions.name: copy-item

itemId.description: The ID of the file or folder to copy. Example: "01A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J1K2L3M4N5O6P7Q8R9S0T1U2V3W4X5Y6Z7"

targetParentId.description: The ID of the destination folder where the item should be copied. Example: "targetFolderId123"

newName.description: Optional new name for the copied item. If not provided, the original name will be used.

actions.description: Create a folder in OneDrive.
actions.name: create-folder

parentItemId.description: The ID of the parent item where the folder will be created. Use "root" to create in the root.

name.description: The name of the new folder.

actions.description: Create a share link for a file or folder.
actions.name: create-sharing-link

itemId.description: The ID of the driveItem to share. Example: "01X2Y3Z4ABC5DEF6G7H8I9J0K"

type.description: The type of sharing link to create. view: read-only, edit: read-write, embed: embeddable link.

scope.description: The scope of the sharing link. anonymous: anyone with the link, organization: only organization members.

password.description: Optional password for the sharing link.

expirationDateTime.description: Optional expiration date/time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"

actions.description: Start a resumable upload for a large file.
actions.name: create-upload-session

parentItemId.description: The ID of the parent folder where the file will be uploaded. Example: "0123456789abc"

fileName.description: The name of the file to upload. Example: "document.pdf"

actions.description: Delete a file or folder.
actions.name: delete-item

itemId.description: The ID of the item (file or folder) to delete. Example: "0123456789ABC"
The ID of the deleted item

actions.description: Remove a sharing permission from an item
actions.name: delete-permission

itemId.description: The ID of the OneDrive item. Example: "01JRXCVV4F3FS3J3G7QJD2ZRK2O4I3XPGZ"

permissionId.description: The ID of the permission to delete. Example: "1"

success.description: Whether the permission was successfully deleted

actions.description: Retrieve the user drive metadata.
actions.name: get-drive

actions.description: Retrieve a file or folder by ID or path
actions.name: get-item

itemId.description: The unique ID of the item to retrieve. Example: "01X3XYZABC123"

path.description: The path to the item relative to the root. Example: "/Documents/file.txt" or "Documents/folder"

actions.description: Retrieve a sharing permission on an item
actions.name: get-permission

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item. Example: "01A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8I9J0K1L2M3N4O5P6Q7R8S9T0U1V2W3X4Y5Z6"

permissionId.description: The ID of the permission. Example: "1"

actions.description: Grant item access to recipients and optionally send invitations.
actions.name: invite-recipients

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to share. Example: "0123456789ABC"

email.description: Email address of the recipient. Example: "ryan@contoso.com"

objectId.description: The unique identifier of the recipient in Microsoft Entra ID.

alias.description: The alias of the recipient. Example: "family" for a family sharing link.

recipients.description: A collection of recipients who receive access and the sharing invitation.

roles.description: The roles to grant to the recipients. Valid values: "read", "write"

requireSignIn.description: Specifies whether the recipient must sign in to view the shared item.

sendInvitation.description: If true, sends a sharing link to the recipient. Otherwise, grants permission without sending a notification.

message.description: A plain text message included in the sharing invitation. Maximum length: 2,000 characters.

password.description: The password set on the invite by the creator. Optional and OneDrive for home only.

expirationDateTime.description: The dateTime after which the permission expires.

retainInheritedPermissions.description: If true (default), any existing inherited permissions are retained when sharing for the first time.

actions.description: List items under a folder
actions.name: list-children

itemId.description: Item ID of the folder. Use "root" or omit to list root children. Example: "0123456789ABCDEF!123"

actions.description: List drives available to the authenticated user.
actions.name: list-drives

id.description: The unique identifier of the drive.

driveType.description: The type of drive (personal, business, or documentLibrary).

ownerId.description: The ID of the drive owner.

ownerName.description: The display name of the drive owner.

drives.description: List of drives available to the authenticated user.

actions.description: List sharing permissions on an item
actions.name: list-permissions

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item. Example: "5D33DD65C6932946!70859"

actions.description: List recently used items from the user drive.
actions.name: list-recent-items

actions.description: List items shared with the user.
actions.name: list-shared-items

cursor.description: Pagination token from the previous response ($skiptoken value). Omit for the first page. Example: "abc123"

nextCursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

actions.description: List versions for a file.
actions.name: list-versions

itemId.description: The ID of the file to list versions for. Example: "0123456789ABC!123"

actions.description: Move or rename a file or folder
actions.name: move-item

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to move or rename. Example: "0123456789abc"

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the destination folder to move the item to. If omitted, the item stays in the same location.

name.description: The new name for the item. If omitted, the item keeps its current name.

id.description: The ID of the moved/renamed item

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder

actions.description: Search drive items by keyword
actions.name: search-items

actions.description: Update mutable file or folder metadata.
actions.name: update-item

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to update. Example: 01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK

name.description: The new name for the item. Example: new-file-name.docx

description.description: The description of the item. Set to null to clear. Example: Project documentation file

createdDateTime.description: The UTC date and time the file was created. Example: 2024-01-15T10:00:00Z

lastModifiedDateTime.description: The UTC date and time the file was last modified. Example: 2024-01-15T10:00:00Z

parentReference.description: Parent reference to move the item to a different location

id.description: The ID of the parent item. Example: 01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the parent. Example: b!dRdbR4F600000000000000000000000

path.description: The path of the parent. Example: /drive/root:/Documents

actions.description: Upload a small file in a single request.
actions.name: upload-small-file

parent_item_id.description: The ID of the parent folder where the file will be uploaded. Example: "0123456789ABCDEF!1234"

file_name.description: The name of the file to create. Example: "document.txt"

content.description: The binary content of the file as a base64-encoded string.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the file content. Defaults to "application/octet-stream".

id.description: The ID of the uploaded file.

name.description: The name of the uploaded file.

size.description: The size of the uploaded file in bytes.

web_url.description: The URL to open the file in OneDrive.

created_date_time.description: The UTC date and time the file was created.

last_modified_date_time.description: The UTC date and time the file was last modified.

download_url.description: A temporary download URL for the file content.

syncs.description: Sync the OneDrive file and folder hierarchy using drive root delta.
syncs.name: drive-items

syncs.description: Sync recently used drive items from OneDrive
syncs.name: recent-items

syncs.description: Sync items shared with the user
syncs.name: shared-items

syncs.description: Sync selected OneDrive files from metadata
syncs.name: user-files-selection

syncs.description: Sync file metadata from the user OneDrive
syncs.name: user-files
